pages.title: Cue and response
pages.text: The Apostle throws Phantom Daggers configured to return to their owner after a separate return delay. Sidestep their path and watch the return pass rather than remaining on the old line after the first flight. At close range leave room to escape its side sweep.

pages.title: Ordinary combat
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: book, paper. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
